en.title: Largest Team with Consecutive Adjacent Skills
en.description:
Select as many students as possible such that, after sorting by skill, any two adjacent students differ by 0 or 1. The team may span several consecutive skill values; the team's maximum minus minimum is not required to be ≤1.

The standard input/output format and examples were compiled by this site; ranges explicitly marked as this site's are not the source's original constraints.
en.input: The first line contains n, and the second line contains the skills. The source has no numeric bounds; on this site 1≤n≤200000, −10^9≤skill≤10^9.
en.explanation: The examples give 3, 4 and 2 respectively. The source editorial only counts two adjacent values, which conflicts with the statement body and the first example; this site corrects it according to the body.
hints: After sorting, accumulate the length of each run whose adjacent differences are ≤1, and start over whenever a larger gap appears.
